packages.name: commonstar-desktop
packages.contents: Tauri 2 and React/TypeScript learner application, launcher, accessibility resources
packages.permissions: Typed local IPC; no provider secrets in the webview

packages.name: commonstar-core
packages.contents: Rust orchestrator, SQLCipher vault, permissions, retrieval, validated memory writes and versioned schema migrations
packages.permissions: Only unlocked active profile; explicit export, backup and provider routing

packages.name: commonstar-parser-workers
packages.contents: Reviewed document extraction workers and bounded OCR adapters
packages.permissions: Single granted input and bounded output; no network or vault directory access

packages.name: commonstar-runtime-cpu
packages.contents: Pinned llama.cpp CPU worker and Commonstar process supervisor
packages.permissions: Read-only verified model files; authenticated private IPC/loopback API; external outbound traffic denied; no vault access

packages.name: commonstar-runtime-gpu
packages.contents: Optional platform-specific accelerated worker built from the same reviewed runtime pin
packages.permissions: Explicit required GPU device access; CPU fallback without loss of vault data

packages.name: commonstar-models
packages.contents: Model catalog, checksums, attribution and capability manifests
packages.permissions: Staged model downloads/imports; no arbitrary upstream execution or learner-data upload

packages.name: commonstar-content
packages.contents: Original or license-compatible reviewed educational packs and provenance
packages.runs_as: learner reads; administrator or authorized learner installs
packages.permissions: Versioned content store; content instructions never gain system authority

packages.name: commonstar-backup
packages.contents: Consistent encrypted vault snapshot, backup and restore integration
packages.permissions: Selected vault snapshot and one selected backup destination; decryption key remains under local custodian control

packages.name: commonstar-distro
packages.contents: OS metapackage, first-run setup, policies, branding, update and recovery integration
packages.runs_as: root only during reviewed OS administration
packages.permissions: No model or browser runs as root; no telemetry collector

packages.name: commonstar-workstation
packages.contents: Optional Ubuntu inference worker, credential and SSH/TLS setup guidance
packages.permissions: Request-scoped context in memory; no authoritative vault or saved conversation service

persistence.vault: Per-learner private state directory; SQLCipher database and encrypted attachments; OS-level encrypted volume
persistence.models: Versioned read-only shared store with manifests and no learner information
persistence.content: Versioned read-only reviewed packs; user imports enter the learner's encrypted vault
persistence.runtime_temp: Private ephemeral directory; no prompt logging or persistent KV-cache files
persistence.secrets: OS keyring or protected per-user credential file; not Git, desktop bundle, model pack or cloud backup plaintext
persistence.exports: Explicit learner/custodian-authorized destination with disclosed scope and retention

abi_policy: Build and test separate Debian/Ubuntu package artifacts where system dependencies differ; architecture support does not establish device certification.
